wants.topic: Maa Durga directly stepping into dramatic human conflicts and helping emotional/persecuted devotees
wants.evidence: GuruVaani Studio videos featuring Maa Durga interacting with an old woman, stepmother, and Chanda achieved massive performance (vsNormal 40.18 to 278.07).

wants.topic: Lesser-known Puranic and Mahabharat backstories (Sati vs Brahma, Satyavati & Rishi Parashar, Sati Anusuya test)
wants.evidence: Mystery of the World top videos focused on detailed Puranic events beat normal views by 13.68x to 43.76x.

wants.topic: Modern saint miracle stories connected to ancient avatars (Neem Karoli Baba as Hanuman avatar)
wants.evidence: Anant Gatha's top videos on Neem Karoli Baba reached over 11M views with vsNormal scores between 20.69 and 44.78.

wants.topic: Apologetic and philosophical explanations of Sanatana Dharma traditions (e.g., why many gods exist in Hinduism)
wants.evidence: Bk Usha Motivational's video explaining multiple gods in Hinduism gained 1.7M views with a vsNormal of 147.57.

wants.topic: Multi-part Swayamvar storytelling with impossible conditions and hero trials
wants.evidence: THE BH STORIES scored consistently high vsNormal (12.93 to 36.78) across multiple parts of the Swayamvar narrative.

gaps: Dramatic, emotionally intense character studies of Puranic women (Sati, Satyavati, Anusuya) presented with detailed narrative katha rather than summary documentary style.
Logical and engaging explanations of everyday Hindu philosophical doubts (polytheism vs monotheism, divine omnipresence) simplified for general audiences.
High-quality, long-form cinematic presentations (Full Movie / 4K narrative) combining ancient divine avatars with modern saint miracles.
saturated: Generic generic moral stories without prominent deity figures or epic drama (e.g., Thakur ji and Bhondu, generic moral stories).
Gimmicky or absurd fictional AI crossover stories involving strange animals (e.g., Princess marrying turtle or Gorilla at swayamvar).
Dry historical/political documentaries (e.g., Chanakya & Chandragupta) on pure devotional channels.
Overdone generic temple mysteries and repetitive festival explainer videos (e.g., Jagannath Puri mystery, Pitru Paksha generic mystery).
